rationale: Mufaddal brings 15+ years of embedded systems expertise across automotive, IoT, and connectivity—domains where verifiable computation and cryptographic primitives are increasingly critical for secure OTA updates and hardware-software integration. Ming is architecting zkVMs and verifiable compute systems designed for universal, near-real-time proof generation; his work on Ziren and the DAC Economy philosophy could benefit from deep embedded systems perspective on real-world deployment constraints and hardware trust models that Mufaddal has navigated across LiveWire, Volkswagen, and tier-1 automotive suppliers.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Ming Guo—he's building zkVM infrastructure for verifiable compute, and your embedded systems background across EV charging, OTA architecture, and automotive-grade software delivery could offer valuable perspective on how these cryptographic primitives integrate into real hardware and connectivity stacks.
